name: The Meaning of Life is to Just ■■■■
source:
Kurokawa Utsuko is a depressed girl with no friends and no reason to live besides a girl named Kawakami Aiko, who ironically, is in a suicide cult that worships the ideal of savior in the "holy angels' domain." One day...she asks Utsuko to join her on the day of reckoning for a double suicide by the end of the week. She agrees...but will she geniunely follow through? TUNE IN TO FIND OUT!
